# Core Web Vitals

> A Next.js demo site for exploring Core Web Vitals optimization techniques. Built for Lighthouse performance walkthroughs.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nextjs-lighthouse-gamma.vercel.app/): Population lookup tool with fuzzy country search, an optimized hero image, and a lazy-loaded code sample modal.

## Features

- Fuzzy search over country population data using Fuse.js and lodash, loaded on demand
- LCP-optimized hero image served via next/image with priority loading
- Dynamically imported modal component (client-side only) for a code sample
